Updated ExtensionNotificationBindings: transcript.marker bindings are derived from packages/shared/src/extension-transcript-markers.ts, which runtime-event-projection.ts reads to emit a system marker row with a fixed label; extensionHandlers.ts returns for that consumer. Checked against the registry derivation, the projection case, the handler branch and the exact-set binding test.

Dated decision record. Its exact-tuple, evidence-tagged, no-wildcard rule still holds: the new transcript.marker entries are exact tuples with an emitter tag, derived into the same registry. The 'consumed by the ACP adapter and the UI renderer' line remains true; the projection reads the marker table the registry derives from.

Extension Rendering: added that attached-session sources' compaction and rewind markers are separate evidenced bindings drawn by the transcript projection as a quiet line, not an ephemeral message. Kiro rendering claims unchanged and still match extensionHandlers.ts.

runtime-event-projection.ts gained an extension.notification case that emits a marker row for listed tuples only; tool, approval and policy-denied projection paths this document describes are untouched.
AttachedSessionDetail.tsx now renders a projected marker row as a quiet line before the presentation branch; continuation, read-only and composer behavior described here is unchanged.
MessageBubble.tsx gained an early return for a transcript-marker row; checkpoint restore affordances on assistant rows are unchanged.
